import shlex
import unittest
from words import split

Q, D, B = "'", '"', "\\"
GOOD = ["", "   ", "a", " a  b\tc\nd\re ", "a" + D + "b c" + D + Q + "d" + Q, "a " + Q + Q + " b", D + D, Q + Q + Q + Q,
        "a" + B + " b c", B + B, B + Q, B + D + "x", D + "a" + B + D + "b" + D, D + "a" + B + B + "b" + D,
        D + "a" + B + "nb" + D, D + "a" + B + Q + "b" + D, Q + "a" + B + Q, Q + "a" + D + "b" + Q, D + "a" + Q + "b" + D,
        "x=#1 $y *.py", "#not a comment", "a" + B + "\nb", D + "a" + B + "\nb" + D, Q + "a\nb" + Q + " c",
        "echo " + D + "it" + Q + "s" + D + " " + Q + "say " + D + "hi" + D + Q, "a" + D + D + "b", Q + Q + "a", "a" + Q + Q,
        B + "a" + B + "b" + B + "c", D + B + "a" + D, "a " + Q + "b" + Q + D + "c" + D + B + " d e", "\t" + Q + "x" + Q + "\t",
        D + "$HOME/my dir" + D + "/file", "k=" + Q + "v w" + Q + " -n" + B + " 1", Q + Q + D + D + Q + Q, "a" + B + B + " b",
        D + B + B + B + D + D]
BAD = [Q + "abc", D + "abc", "abc" + B, "a " + Q + "b", D + "a" + B + D, "a " + D + "b " + Q + "c" + Q, Q, D, B, "a" + D + "b" + B]


class H(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_same_as_a_posix_shell(self):
        for line in GOOD:
            self.assertEqual(split(line), shlex.split(line), repr(line))

    def test_unfinished(self):
        for line in BAD:
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                shlex.split(line)
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError, msg=repr(line)):
                split(line)

    def test_splits_by_itself(self):
        with open("words.py") as f:
            self.assertNotIn("shlex", f.read())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
